name: Stash v0.9.121
body:
Full art: Now Playing's art fills the screen, and the album's pages turn behind the controls as the song plays.

## What's new

- **Full art.** Now Playing's cover now fills the top of the screen, fading into the controls below. As the song plays, the art moves on to the back cover and the pages inside, drifting slowly across each one so you see all of it. Swipe across the art to turn a page yourself. Prefer the square cover? Tap the arrows button at the top of Now Playing to switch, and Now Playing remembers which way you left it.
- **Make full art yours.** In **Settings → Appearance → Full art**, choose how close the art is (zoom all the way out to see the whole cover), how fast it drifts (or stop the drift), and whether it fades into a blur of the art or a solid color.
- **The title, your way.** The song title now sits on the left. In **Settings → Appearance → Now Playing** you can put it back in the center, and choose the button beside it: the sleep timer, nothing at all, or a shortcut like Lyrics, Queue, Radio or Share.
- **Discogs art is your call.** Some back covers and inside pages come from Discogs, where people upload their own photos, and some of those are low quality. Turn off **Settings → Appearance → Now Playing → Discogs art** to see only the scans from the Cover Art Archive.
- **Stash in your language.** Stash now follows your phone's language, or pick one in **Settings → Appearance → Language**. Settings is translated into 13 languages so far, including Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish; the rest of the app will follow. Thanks to @ParaliyzedEvo and everyone translating on Crowdin.

## UX polish

- Lyrics open smoothly over full art, and the live lyrics line sits right on the art.
- The artist and album under the song title get the full width, so long album names aren't cut short.
- Stash now fills in missing albums only for songs you've played or saved, so it does less work in the background.

## Bug fixes

- After the art had cycled to the back cover, turning it over and back could leave it stuck on the back. It now always comes back to the front.
- An artist page opened without a connection stayed blank for hours, even after you were back online. It now shows a Retry button that loads the page. Thanks to @ddanialb.
- Tapping an artist from a song could open a different artist with a similar name. It now opens the right one, or tells you it couldn't find them. Thanks to @ddanialb.

## Install

Download `Stash.apk` below and open it on your Android device. If you've got a previous Stash release installed, this upgrades in place — your library, sync history, and settings are preserved.

**Requires:** Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.

See the [README](https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash#install) for first-time setup.


## What's Changed
* Last.fm proxy: cache "not found", answer unfindable lookups itself by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/700
* Now Playing: full art, title and art settings, Discogs switch by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/701
* Fix artist pages stuck empty after a failed load, and wrong-artist resolution by @ddanialb in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/698
* Add in-app language picker by @ParaliyzedEvo in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/699
* Now Playing: the owner's setup as the default; artist line gets the full width by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/702

## New Contributors
* @ddanialb made their first contribution in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/698

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/compare/v0.9.120...v0.9.121
